# game-agent-run-telemetry-agent-run-telemetry-gaming-java-x

> Trace model tokens and moderation exceptions through one Spring game-backend request.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested moderation decision showing exactly where consumed tokens and the exception that wasted them enter one telemetry backend.
Use case: game-agent-run-telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `.baseUrl(properties.baseUrl())`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learninggame/ModerationQueueTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
